About

Designing systems, not just spaces

I'm a game developer and designer specializing in Unreal Engine, C++, and gameplay systems. My work spans solo-built stealth games to collaborative jam titles, but the throughline is the same: every level should teach the player something new about the systems they're standing in.

As World & Level Designer on Lost Origins, I shaped the pacing of a spectral tower-defense siege. As Systems Designer on Flux Eternum and Skybound, I helped tune traversal mechanics — wall-runs, grapples, and dashes — that reward precision over memorization. And on Project Steal, I designed and built solo: a stealth-heist loop where risk scales with reward, house by house.

Whether I'm blocking out a level in grey-box or scripting an enemy behavior tree, I care about the same thing: does this moment feel intentional?

Projects

LEVEL 01 — SOLO PROJECT
Project Steal
StealthRole PlayingSolo Dev

A stealth-heist game where you play a thief working your way up through a city, one mark at a time. Small houses are easy pickings; bigger mansions mean bigger loot but heavier security. The core loop is a risk-reward ladder — crack lockers, dodge patrols, and decide how greedy to get before pulling out.

Role
Solo Designer & Developer
Genre
Stealth / Role Playing
Focus
Risk-reward loop design, mansion layout & security scaling
